invariants: At most one intervention claim and one replay claim per scheduler iteration.
Every intervention terminal node routes to replay claim before Loop Interventions.
An empty intervention claim still routes to replay claim.
An empty replay claim routes to Loop Interventions.
Replay jobs never enter Atomic Claim Intervention.
Replay jobs never use claim_next_job, complete_job, retry_job or dead_letter_job.
Load, complete and retry carry the exact job_id, worker_id, lease_id tuple.
The ingest subflow receives only job_id, worker_id and lease_id and reloads trusted stored payload.
Only mark_webhook_processed === true or deferred_payment_handoff === true permits replay completion.
A false completion/retry result is terminal lease-lost; do not attempt a generic fallback.
All replay business mutations remain sequential and use the 18 transaction-local fenced wrappers in shopify-ingest-replay-write-map.json.
No replay branch connects to HENVALT_DELIVERY or a provider send node.
The existing intervention business branch remains unchanged.
A claim RPC failure stops the scheduler execution; it must not be treated as an empty queue.
A load failure may retry only with the exact lease tuple; complete/retry RPC errors terminate fail-closed.
An empty or incomplete lease-bound load is retried with the exact lease tuple; it is never mistaken for an already-processed event.
An empty claim is a normal queue miss and returns to Loop Interventions; a present but malformed claim is terminal fail-closed.
Replay retry stores only the constant SHOPIFY_REPLAY_PROCESSING_FAILED reason; never persist raw exception text or customer data.
A deferred-payment replay completes only after defer_payment_webhook_reconciliation_fenced returns true and the existing recovery reconciler owns the durable follow-up.
All lease-fenced SQL parameter expressions reference the normalized claim node directly, so load/complete/retry error outputs cannot erase the job/worker/lease tuple.
n8n node execution flags use native top-level node properties (alwaysOutputData and onError), never nested under a synthetic settings object.
dependencies_before_staging: Add a dedicated Execute Workflow Trigger and isolated replay entry in HENVALT_INGEST candidate; reload payload with load_shopify_webhook_replay_job(job_id, worker_id, lease_id).
Reconstruct normalized event only from the trusted loaded webhook row and tenant-bound metadata.
Route the live ingress to durable enqueue and explicit HTTP response before downstream processing; prevent dual ownership between ingress and replay worker.
Apply migrations 001-010 only to isolated disposable/staging PostgreSQL and verify actual n8n credentials and RPC grants.
Test empty queues, intervention success/retry/failure, replay already processed, replay success, replay retry, lease expiry/reclaim, and all terminal loop paths.
Keep provider sending disabled during every staging acceptance test.
Exercise the deferred_payment_handoff output through the Execute Workflow result and confirm the recovery worker completes the replay job only on that explicit boolean.
Use the exact Execute Workflow node v1.4 workflowInputs mapping and Execute Workflow Trigger v1.1 three-string input declaration in executable candidate; reject any extra input field.
Inline the self-contained n8n Code node source from n8n/shopify-replay-claim-normalizer-node-candidate.js; do not attempt a relative import from the repository.
